record.question: From the particulars given below, calculate – (i) Qualifying service for pension, (ii) Pension (iii) Retirement Gratuity and (iv) Family pension admissible to an Officer of the Government of Mizoram who retired on 30.6.2017 on attaining the age of superannuation. [Details: Date of Birth 10.6.1957, Joined service as Clerk 25.8.1984, Promoted as Section Officer 3.11.1992, Promoted as Accounts Officer 10.2.2015, Drawing pay Rs. 22010 pm from 1.7.2015 with DNI on 1.7.2016, Joined MSACS on deputation 1.9.2016 with 10% deputation allowance, Rejoined parent office 1.2.2017 as Group A post with pay Rs. 25150, Transfer in 1997 with 25 days excess joining time treated as dies non, Various spells of leave including half pay leave (17.3.1991-28.5.1991), earned leave (16.6.2001-14.7.2001), extraordinary leave (2.1.2004-26.3.2004), extraordinary leave on medical certificate (4.10.2007-15.12.2007)].
